text: Hi, Tina! We're sorry to hear about your injury.
If you haven't experienced an injury at work before,
you may be uncertain about the claims process and what to expect.
As your employer's workers' compensation insurer,
we at Liberty Mutual are here to help.
Throughout your claim, we'll be in contact with you regarding the progress of your recovery,
and we encourage you to maintain communication with your claim specialist as well as your employer.
Our goal is to ensure your successful recovery and return to work.
Your employer, through Liberty Mutual, partners with medical provider networks,
which include providers experienced in treating workplace injuries.
In some situations, you may be able to select your own provider.
If you have questions about treating with a certain provider, please contact your claim specialist.
A payment was issued for your lost wages covering this period.
The amount may have been estimated and may be subject to change.
Your claim specialist can answer any questions you may have about this payment.
To receive potential future benefit payments in a fast and easy manner,
consider signing up for electronic funds transfer, which you may be eligible for.
That way, owed benefits can be directly deposited to your bank account.
When it comes to your medical treatment,
please ask providers to submit bills directly to us for consideration.
We also have a pharmacy program, which may cover the cost of prescriptions for your injury.
Be sure to bring the card you receive in the mail with you to the pharmacy.
If you have not yet received your card, please contact your claim specialist.
And remember to check the helpful resources available at your fingertips,
such as the Injured Worker Toolkit,
where you can access your claim information and the status of lost wage and medical payments.
And if you have any questions about your claim, feel free to reach out to your claim specialist.
We wish you a speedy recovery.
To enroll in electronic funds transfer,
register for Injured Workers Toolkit,
or visit the provider directory.
Just click the buttons on your screen.
Please take note of your claim number,
which is how your claim is identified by your claim specialist and medical providers.
And if you have more questions, just contact your claim specialist.
